name: Marcus Reed
personality: He is intelligent, technically capable, and deeply anxious. His obsession with strange underground signals has begun to affect his judgement.
appearance: A thin, pale man with restless hands, ink-stained fingers, and dark circles under his eyes.

start.public_state: Continuing limited observatory work while insisting that Director Harlan's disappearance must have a rational explanation.
start.inner_state: Desperate to recover Harlan's missing notebook before Eleanor, Arthur, or anyone else uses it to expose his unauthorized experiments.

intents.name: Recover Harlan's missing notebook
intents.description: Find Harlan's notebook before it exposes Marcus's unauthorized signal experiments.

relationships.label: the mayor
relationships.summary: Someone he answers to when the observatory comes up in town business.

routine.activity: keeps the observatory records and instruments
